stdout:
Create a live chat ban. Use this tool to ban a user from a live chat.

Usage:
  yutu liveChatBan insert [flags]

Examples:
# Ban a user permanently
yutu liveChatBan insert --liveChatId abc123 --bannedUserChannelId UC_xyz --banType permanent
# Ban a user temporarily for 5 minutes
yutu liveChatBan insert --liveChatId abc123 --bannedUserChannelId UC_xyz --banType temporary --banDurationSeconds 300

Flags:
  -d, --banDurationSeconds uint      Duration of the ban in seconds (only for temporary bans)
  -t, --banType string               permanent|temporary
  -b, --bannedUserChannelId string   Channel ID of the user to ban
  -h, --help                         help for insert
  -l, --liveChatId string            ID of the live chat
  -o, --output string                json|yaml|silent
  -p, --parts strings                Parts to include (default [snippet])
      --yes                          Confirm the operation
